title: The Best Apple Black Friday Deals, All in One Place
author: Louryn Strampe
text: Get the best Cyber Week deals on editor-approved gear, straight to your inbox.By signing up, you agree to our user agreement (including class action waiver and arbitration provisions), and acknowledge our privacy policy.All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Apple gear goes hand-in-hand with holiday sales. WIRED readers love opportunities to save on MacBooks, iPads, AirPods, and other gadgets—and while discounts on Apple products aren't especially rare, Black Friday deals do usually drop these sought-after items to their lowest prices of the year.I've rounded up the best discounts on Apple products and accessories below. Everything you see has been hand-tested by someone on the WIRED Reviews team, and every price has been hand-checked ahead of publishing. We'll keep this story updated throughout the weekend.Be sure to check out our dedicated roundups of the Best iPad Deals, Best MacBook Deals, and Best AirPod Deals for more specific picks.Jump To:Best Black Friday Apple Device DealsBest Black Friday Apple Accessory DealsBest Black Friday Apple Device DealsPhotograph: Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallAppleAirPods Pro 3$249 $149 (40% off) Amazon$249 $149 (40% off) Walmart$249 AppleAirPods Pro 3 are finally, actually on sale. The best wireless earbuds for iPhone owners are usually slightly discounted, but this Black Friday price is a truly good deal worth considering if you're in the market for an earbud upgrade. They're comfortable, have great noise cancelation, and have never been this cheap before.Photograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoPhotograph: Adrienne SoAppleAirPods Max 2$549 $419 (24% off) Amazon$549 $419 (24% off) Walmart$549 AppleMost PopularGearThe Best Black Friday 2026 Deals Have LandedBy Simon HillBuying GuidesShop Small: Our Favorite Gifts From Independent BusinessesBy Kat MerckComputers11 WIRED-Approved Gifts for the Techie in Your LifeBy Luke LarsenGearI Drove Around New York City With the Fiat Topolino for a WeekBy Julian ChokkattuFor over-ear headphone enthusiasts looking to keep thing Apple, the AirPods Max 2 are the best option thanks to their clear sound and top-notch noise cancelation. They're also eye-wateringly expensive and basically never drop very far in price. If you've been hemming and hawing trying to figure out a smart time to buy, we think it's right now.Photograph: Harry RabinowitzBeatsPowerbeats Pro 2$250 $180 (28% off) Amazon$250 $180 (28% off) Best BuyWe especially like these earbuds for working out. They fit around your ear so they'll stay in place while running—something AirPods definitely do not do (at least not for me). They have punchy sound and solid noise cancelation, plus dust and water resistance.Photograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenAppleMacBook Air (M5, 2026)$1,299 $999 (23% off) Amazon (13-inch)$1,499 $1,199 (20% off) Amazon (15-inch)$1,299 Apple (13-inch)We love this MacBook and think it's the best option for most people looking to buy a laptop of any kind. The only real drawback is its price, but at $250 off for Black Friday, now is a great time to buy. It strikes a balance between price and performance that WIRED editor Luke Larsen calls “unbeatable,” and it manages to do it in a sleek, high-quality build that inspires confidence.Photograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenPhotograph: Luke LarsenAppleMacBook Neo$699 $649 (7% off) Amazon$700 $650 (7% off) Best Buy$700 $650 (7% off) TargetMost PopularGearThe Best Black Friday 2026 Deals Have LandedBy Simon HillBuying GuidesShop Small: Our Favorite Gifts From Independent BusinessesBy Kat MerckComputers11 WIRED-Approved Gifts for the Techie in Your LifeBy Luke LarsenGearI Drove Around New York City With the Fiat Topolino for a WeekBy Julian ChokkattuThe inexpensive MacBook Neo doesn't drop in price very often, but Black Friday has shaved just a bit off the top ($50). We wish it had more RAM, but otherwise, the Neo is totally adequate for most basic use cases: think internet browsing, office software, video calls, and watching your favorite shows.Photograph: Brenda StolyarPhotograph: Brenda StolyarAppleiPad (2025, A16)$449 $379 (16% off) Amazon$449 $379 (16% off) Walmart$449 $399 (11% off) Best BuyThe base iPad is the model we recommend most often, and while it is no stranger to sales, it's absolutely worth considering if you're thinking about getting someone an iPad as a gift. It isn't powerful enough to be a work machine, but for browsing, content streaming, and “games on your phone,” it'll do the trick.AppleAirTag (2nd Generation)$29 $18 (38% off) Amazon (Single)$99 $79 (20% off) Amazon (4-Pack)In my personal and professional opinion, the Apple AirTag doesn't get enough love. I became an AirTag enthusiast this year and now I have one on my keys, in my car, in my purse, and on my luggage. The four-pack price isn't as enticing as it could be, but picking up a single AirTag for under $20 is a steal. The batteries are replaceable and the Bluetooth tracker can play a loud chime if you're looking for it and can't find it.Best Black Friday Apple Accessory DealsPhotograph: AnkerAnkerNano 3$16 $13 (19% off) AmazonYou can never have enough wall chargers. This option is tiny and comes in colors that match with many iPhones. It has folding prongs and a single USB-C port.
